gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.475512 37.768668)',4326)::geography, 3500)
  AND p.amenity = 'hospital'
  AND elev.z >= 40;

WITH strawberry_hill AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.475512, 37.768668), 4326)::geography, 3500) AS search_area
),
hospitals AS (
  SELECT 
    p.poi_name,
    p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital'
    AND p.addr_city ILIKE 'San Francisco'
    AND p.addr_state ILIKE 'CA'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(ST_Clip(r.rast, (strawberry_hill.search_area)::geometry, TRUE)) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us r, strawberry_hill
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, (strawberry_hill.search_area)::geometry)
),
elevation_values AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(clipped_dem.clipped_raster, 1)).val AS elevation,
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(clipped_dem.clipped_raster, 1)).geom AS rast_geom
  FROM clipped_dem
),
hospital_elevations AS (
  SELECT 
    h.poi_name,
    MAX(e.elevation) AS max_elevation
  FROM hospitals h
  JOIN elevation_values e ON ST_Intersects(h.geometry::geometry, e.rast_geom)
  GROUP BY h.poi_name
)
SELECT 
  poi_name,
  max_elevation
FROM hospital_elevations
WHERE max_elevation >= 40;
